content.value: An industry produces 500 $m ^ { 3 } / \mathsf { d a y }$ of organic waste with a ${ \mathsf { B O D } } _ { 5 }$ of 537 g/l. If wastes with $B O D _ { 5 }$ less than 300 mg/l are covered by basic sewer charges through taxes or as part of the water bill, what bi-annual surcharge this industry would pay if the operating cost for removing ${ \mathsf { B O D } } _ { 5 }$ is \$0.25 per kg ${ \mathsf { B O D } } _ { 5 }$ removed.
